name: Gaffer Jacks

narrative.details:
I came to Auberdine because of the quiet.  I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way.  I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard!  I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Gaffer Jacks to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText: I can't believe you found them! You must be the luckiest friend in Kalimdor!
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find my gaffer jacks, adventurer? Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
